اقترحن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَحْنَ (iqtaraḥna) /iq.ta.raħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اُقْتُرِحْنَ (uqturiḥna) /uq.tu.riħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اِقْتَرِحْنَ (iqtariḥna) /iq.ta.riħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
